title: WP-VER-A: freeze badf-engineering-verification capability contract (G08 two-plane verification; DESIGNED, thin router, no second gate)
objective: Freeze the badf-engineering-verification contract as a declarative router over two planes: the Reviewer plane (docs/03 Reviewer -- isolated, defect-first, read-only, sealed lens passes that PROPOSE findings) and the Verifier plane (docs/03 Verifier -- an approved runtime that OBSERVES integration, contract and composed-tree facts); schemas normalize PROPOSED/OBSERVED artifacts into CANONICAL evidence, the canonical gate evaluates, quality_authority decides. Reuses what BADF has instead of inventing: composition-verification's expected_content_tree + git-staleness CURRENT as the target binding (no new composed-identity field), docs/03's five council verdicts, the evidence outcome enum for contract results (INDETERMINATE -> BLOCKED, never PASS), the architecture-assurance finding item extended with lens/reporters, badf_compose.py as the composed run (BLD-I09), run-ledger-event records, check_non_coverage extended per artifact. Security lens routed to badf-security-assurance (named, not built) with declared non-coverage; independence execution-level with the single-collaborator deviation carried. Adapts Codex review-agent, Apache Magpie and qa-tester as REFERENCE only, rejecting their authority semantics. VER-I01..I20 frozen; no runtime, no validator, no schema, no lifecycle change, no gate change.
business_value: Every AI reviewer can say LGTM and every CI can go green; BADF needs a G08 whose review cannot impersonate observation, whose observation cannot impersonate approval, whose empty finding set cannot serialize as correctness, and whose evidence binds the tree that will actually land. The freeze makes that contract the thing later rungs implement, enforce and shadow, instead of an opinion.
